correctness.rationale: For each k≥2 the exchangeable pair variables u(t)=P(H≠L1),v(t)=P(L1≠L2) satisfy the exact 2×2 linear ODE u′=−(α+β)u+(k−1)β v/k, v′=2α(u−v) with initial 2ρ(1−ρ). Determinant of stable matrix=2α(α+β/k)>0, negative trace. Cramer resolvent gives Jδ and differentiating at fixed α,k,ρ,δ gives numerator 2ρ(1−ρ)(δ+2α)[α(k−3)−δ], strictly controlling signs for k=2,3,≥4 and equality. Independently factored derivative with symbolic algebra; exact full-state checker was read but not executed unmodified.
residual_risks: Initial opinions must be iid Bernoulli and rates per vertex; expectation of any other statistic is not covered.
